title: Sam Morgan's earlier and later bands
summary: Interviewers sort out Sam Morgan's earlier band with Joe Watson from the later one with Isaiah.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: When Sam came here, was that the earlier band he had with Isaiah Morgan? I mean, that was the later band, wasn't it, was Isaiah?
Well, if it had earlier, it would have been the later band. Joe Watson was with the earlier band, right? Yeah.
Did you always get out with him when you saw him hit?

Well, that would have been Joe Watson in those times. Yeah, yeah. Who was a Yanker buddy, I could never remember. Yanker. Yanker. And Alfred on drums. I guess Marrero on bass, Simon Drunk. I don't know, I forget it.

And I think Simon played big, John played with him too. John played with him too. Yeah, John played with him too. Yeah, John played with him. And Simon. Yeah. And, yeah, I wasn't with him then. Isaiah wasn't with him then. That was his earlier band. But after Isaiah started playing underneath, he worked out there in his band as the second trumpet player. Yeah.
Well, when he got together with Isaiah, where were you living? I was in New Orleans. You were in New Orleans, yeah. So that was later here. Yeah, I was in New Orleans.
